name: live-hunt
notes: #353 AnimLab live test: the real game in play mode (seed 4242, the living land), a camp with rabbits in the meadow (HuntViewPlayTests' setup), then EcoDebug.StartHunt: a real hunter after a real rabbit of the herd. The cameras follow whoever is on a hunt step. Then the view clock skips 0.55 h, so the 10 s recorded hold the stalk, the strike and the catch.

setup: AquariumCiv.View.PeopleView.DebugSetHour(9f); foreach (var p in new[] { (-1.6f, 0.6f), (-1.0f, -0.8f), (-2.0f, -0.2f), (1.6f, 0.9f) }) AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.MistBig(p.Item1, p.Item2); AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.SkipSeasons(1); AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.OpenCampGate(); var sim = AquariumCiv.Game.GameClock.Instance.ActiveSim; for (int i = 0; i < 12 && sim.State.era != AquariumCiv.Sim.Era.Camp; i++) { AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.MistCamp(); AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.SkipSeasons(1); } AquariumCiv.View.EcoDebug.AddRabbits(6); AquariumCiv.View.PeopleView.DebugSetHour(9f); return "era " + sim.State.era + ", rabbits " + sim.EcoRabbitCount;
